· 保存：记住当前顺序和配置\n· 读取：打开上次保存的内容\n· 重置：清空当:
· Save: remember the current order and configuration
· Read: open the last saved content
· Reset: clear the current selection
· Restore: bring back what was selected before this reset
· 黑名单：默认带有任一黑名单词条的驱动不参与配装；开启“黑名单为零权重”后不再:
· Blacklist: by default a Module carrying any blacklisted stat takes no part in the loadout; with "Blacklist as zero weight" enabled it is no longer a hard filter, and blacklisted stats count as 0 in the Module Top-K score
· Cartridge main stats: only the selected main stats are used
· Substats: the earlier the higher the priority; when there is no solution it relaxes one layer at a time and finally falls back to the full candidate pool
· Equal priority: selection switches to the number of matches
· Minimum effective level: only Modules at or above that level receive custom stat matches; lower-level Modules can still fill blueprint shapes
· No score tier limit: every Module receives custom stat matches
· 检查：5% 基础 + 卡带/驱动暴击率 + 实际额外驱动加成 + 弧盘无条件:
· Check: 5% base + Cartridge/Module CRIT Rate + actual extra Module bonus + Arc unconditional permanent CRIT Rate + enabled Affection CRIT Rate
· Only you change this value manually; leaving it empty sets no minimum, and a plan that misses it is invalid
· 自动上限：100% − 本次有效弧盘无条件常驻暴击率 − 已启用好感暴击率\:
· Automatic cap: 100% − this run's effective Arc unconditional permanent CRIT Rate − enabled Affection CRIT Rate
· Check: 5% base + Cartridge/Module CRIT Rate + actual extra Module bonus
· A manually entered value is used as-is, and a manual 0 means no limit; an automatically computed 0 is still a cap, and a plan above the cap is invalid; while the Arc permanent data is pending review the automatic cap cannot be checked
· 四件套：凑齐目标套装的 4 个驱动形状\n· 二件套：凑齐其中 2 个，其余:
· 4-piece: complete 4 Module shapes of the target set
· 2-piece: complete 2 of them, and prefer extra shapes in the remaining positions
· No effect: do not require the set, and prefer extra shapes
· Defaults to 4-piece when not set
